pageDescription: Oversea students are those who currently live outside of the U.S. and will apply for a STUDENT VISA.
title: Oversea Students
subtitle: Oversea students are those who currently live outside of the U.S. and will apply for a STUDENT VISA.
OR
Already have a STUDENT VISA and will re-enter to the US from another country.

category.title: Application Steps
lists: Apply to MLI (Fill out on-line application)
Submit supporting documents for an I-20
Apply for a student Visa and have a Visa interview at the U.S. Embassy
description: Students should apply to MLI at least 2 months before their desired program starting date. We will guide you through the application steps after you submit your on-line application for MLI.

category.title: Cancellation Policy
description: The enrollment fee of $150 will be charged at the time of application. The enrollment fee is non-refundable regardless if a visa application is rejected or enrollment is cancelled.

category.title: After submitting your application
description:
After students submit the on-line application, MLI will process your application and send you the link for the iMLI (Each Student's on-line application page).
Students can follow the continued application process stated on iMLI.

applyOnline.title: Apply Online
description:
Fill out the on-line application.
Contact us via e-mail with any questions.
Apply to MLI through the on-line application below.
